592	    def pull_queue(
593	        self, execution_id: str, name: str, raw: Any, key: str | None, tenant: str = DEFAULT_TENANT
594	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
595	        self._empty_body(raw, "pull")
596	
597	        def apply() -> dict[str, Any]:
598	            self.get_execution(execution_id, tenant)
599	            queue_row = self._queue_row(execution_id, name, tenant)
600	            if queue_row is None:
601	                raise NotFoundError(f"queue {name} was not found for execution {execution_id}")
602	            subscription = self.store.decode(queue_row["document"])
603	            visibility = subscription["visibility_seconds"]
604	            now = time.time()
605	            delivered = []
606	            for message_row in self._queue_message_rows(execution_id, name, tenant):
607	                message = self.store.decode(message_row["document"])
608	                if self._effective_queue_status(message, now) != "pending":
609	                    continue
610	                # The message leaves the pending set until the visibility
611	                # deadline; unacknowledged by then, it becomes pending again.
612	                message["status"] = "delivered"
613	                message["invisible_until"] = now + visibility
614	                message["delivery_count"] += 1
615	                message["deliveries"].append(
616	                    {"delivered_at": self.store.now(), "delivery": message["delivery_count"]}
617	                )
618	                self.store.connection.execute(
619	                    "UPDATE queue_messages SET document = ? "
620	                    "WHERE tenant = ? AND execution_id = ? AND queue = ? AND sequence = ?",
621	                    (self.store.encode(message), tenant, execution_id, name, message_row["sequence"]),
622	                )
623	                # Every delivery to the caller is metered as a delivery
624	                # attempt, atomically with the pull that made it.
625	                self._record_usage(tenant, USAGE_TYPE_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED)
626	                delivered.append(self._render_queue_message(message_row["sequence"], message, now))
627	            # An empty queue (or one with nothing currently deliverable) is a
628	            # definite empty result, not an error.
629	            return {"messages": delivered}
630	
631	        with self._operation():
632	            return self._idempotent(key, f"pull-queue:{execution_id}:{name}", apply, tenant)
633	
634	    def ack_queue(
635	        self, execution_id: str, name: str, raw: Any, key: str | None, tenant: str = DEFAULT_TENANT
636	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
637	        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"idempotency_key"}:
638	            raise ValidationError("ack body must contain exactly an idempotency_key string")
639	        idempotency_key = raw["idempotency_key"]
640	        if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or not idempotency_key:
641	            raise ValidationError("ack idempotency_key must be a non-empty string")
642	
643	        def apply() -> dict[str, Any]:
644	            self.get_execution(execution_id, tenant)
645	            if self._queue_row(execution_id, name, tenant) is None:
646	                raise NotFoundError(f"queue {name} was not found for execution {execution_id}")
647	            for message_row in self._queue_message_rows(execution_id, name, tenant):
648	                message = self.store.decode(message_row["document"])
649	                if message["idempotency_key"] != idempotency_key:
650	                    continue
651	                if message["status"] == "acknowledged":
652	                    # A repeated acknowledgement names a message that already
653	                    # left the queue: it is missing, like an unknown key.
654	                    raise NotFoundError(f"queue message {idempotency_key} was not found")
655	                message["status"] = "acknowledged"
656	                message["invisible_until"] = None
657	                self.store.connection.execute(
658	                    "UPDATE queue_messages SET document = ? "
659	                    "WHERE tenant = ? AND execution_id = ? AND queue = ? AND sequence = ?",
660	                    (self.store.encode(message), tenant, execution_id, name, message_row["sequence"]),
661	                )
662	                return {"acknowledged": True}
663	            raise NotFoundError(f"queue message {idempotency_key} was not found")
664	
665	        with self._operation():
666	            return self._idempotent(key, f"ack-queue:{execution_id}:{name}", apply, tenant)

752	    # --- operational metrics ---------------------------------------------
753	
754	    def metrics(
755	        self,
756	        tenant: str,
757	        since: datetime | None = None,
758	        until: datetime | None = None,
759	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
760	        """Aggregate the tenant's persisted business facts into run metrics.
761	
762	        The query is read-only: it appends no events, writes no usage records,
763	        and settles nothing (a due timeout stays unsettled until an operation
764	        observes it), so the answer reflects exactly what is stored. Every
765	        dimension is always present — a tenant with no recorded facts gets a
766	        definite all-zero result rather than an error.
767	
768	        ``since`` and ``until`` bound a closed interval on the facts'
769	        occurrence times: a fact whose time equals either endpoint is counted.
770	        A window with ``since`` later than ``until`` simply contains no facts,
771	        so every dimension reports zero.
772	        """
773	        if not tenant:
774	            raise ValidationError("tenant id must be a non-empty string")
775	        with self._operation():
776	            with self.store.transaction():
777	                return self._metrics_counts(tenant, since, until)
778	
779	    def _metrics_counts(
780	        self,
781	        tenant: str,
782	        since: datetime | None,
783	        until: datetime | None,
784	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
785	        """Compute the metrics document; the caller validates the tenant and holds a transaction."""
786	        # A window with since later than until contains no facts at all, so its
787	        # result is the same definite zero shape as a tenant with no facts.
788	        empty_window = since is not None and until is not None and since > until
789	
790	        distribution: dict[str, Any] = {
791	            "running": 0,
792	            "completed": 0,
793	            "terminated": {reason: 0 for reason in TERMINATION_REASONS},
794	        }
795	        # Each execution contributes exactly one status fact: a running
796	        # execution's fact is its execution_started event, while a completed or
797	        # terminated execution's fact is the event that established that
798	        # status. With no window this counts every execution once, exactly as
799	        # the unfiltered baseline does. An execution has at most one terminal
800	        # event, so the join never multiplies rows.
801	        if not empty_window:
802	            status_rows = self.store.connection.execute(
803	                "SELECT e.state, COALESCE(t.occurred_at, s.occurred_at) AS at "
804	                "FROM executions e "
805	                "JOIN events s ON s.tenant = e.tenant AND s.execution_id = e.id AND s.type = 'execution_started' "
806	                "LEFT JOIN events t ON t.tenant = e.tenant AND t.execution_id = e.id "
807	                "AND t.type IN ('execution_completed', 'execution_terminated') "
808	                "WHERE e.tenant = ?",
809	                (tenant,),
810	            ).fetchall()
811	            for row in status_rows:
812	                if not self._within_window(_parse_stored_time(row["at"]), since, until):
813	                    continue
814	                state = self.store.decode(row["state"])
815	                status = state["status"]
816	                if status == "terminated":
817	                    reason = state.get("termination_reason")
818	                    if reason in distribution["terminated"]:
819	                        distribution["terminated"][reason] += 1
820	                elif status in ("running", "completed"):
821	                    distribution[status] += 1
822	
823	        # Completion, failure, and retry consumption are counted from
824	        # the recorded node events: condition evaluations and skips
825	        # append their own event types and are never counted here, and
826	        # loop body nodes accumulate one event per iteration. A version
827	        # migration appends no node events, so facts recorded before
828	        # and after it accumulate under the same node identifiers.
829	        completions: dict[str, int] = {}
830	        failures: dict[str, int] = {}
831	        retries: dict[str, int] = {}
832	        buckets = {
833	            "node_completed": completions,
834	            "node_failed": failures,
835	            "node_retried": retries,
836	        }
837	        if not empty_window:
838	            rows = self.store.connection.execute(
839	                "SELECT type, payload, occurred_at FROM events WHERE tenant = ? "
840	                "AND type IN ('node_completed', 'node_failed', 'node_retried')",
841	                (tenant,),
842	            ).fetchall()
843	            for row in rows:
844	                if not self._within_window(_parse_stored_time(row["occurred_at"]), since, until):
845	                    continue
846	                node_id = self.store.decode(row["payload"])["node_id"]
847	                bucket = buckets[row["type"]]
848	                bucket[node_id] = bucket.get(node_id, 0) + 1
849	
850	        # Delivery outcomes are counted per outbound HTTP attempt, so
851	        # a delivery that fails and then succeeds on a retry records
852	        # one of each; an attempt succeeded exactly when it received a
853	        # 2xx status code. A delivery document carries the single
854	        # occurred_at of the delivery record, shared by every attempt
855	        # recorded in it.
856	        succeeded = 0
857	        failed = 0
858	        if not empty_window:
859	            rows = self.store.connection.execute(
860	                "SELECT document FROM deliveries WHERE tenant = ?",
861	                (tenant,),
862	            ).fetchall()
863	            for row in rows:
864	                document = self.store.decode(row["document"])
865	                if since is not None or until is not None:
866	                    occurred_at = document.get("occurred_at")
867	                    if not isinstance(occurred_at, str) or not self._within_window(
868	                        _parse_stored_time(occurred_at), since, until
869	                    ):
870	                        continue
871	                attempts = document.get("attempts")
872	                if not isinstance(attempts, list):
873	                    continue
874	                for attempt in attempts:
875	                    status_code = attempt.get("status_code") if isinstance(attempt, dict) else None
876	                    if isinstance(status_code, int) and 200 <= status_code < 300:
877	                        succeeded += 1
878	                    else:
879	                        failed += 1
880	
881	        # One trigger row exists per settled schedule period, so a
882	        # repeated settlement of the same period counts nothing more.
883	        triggers: dict[str, int] = {}
884	        if not empty_window:
885	            rows = self.store.connection.execute(
886	                "SELECT workflow_id, triggered_at, COUNT(*) AS count FROM schedule_triggers "

914	    def metrics_export(
915	        self,
916	        tenant: str,
917	        since: datetime | None = None,
918	        until: datetime | None = None,
919	    ) -> str:
920	        """Render the filtered metrics in the Prometheus text exposition format.
921	
922	        Every top-level dimension is one metric family named with the
923	        ``chronicleflow_`` prefix and the dimension's public key. Families
924	        appear in the documented top-level key order; samples within a family
925	        are ordered by ascending label value. Every family carries at least
926	        one zero-valued sample when it has no facts, values are decimal
927	        integers, every line ends with a newline, and the whole document ends
928	        with a single newline.
929	        """
930	        counts = self.metrics(tenant, since, until)
931	        status = counts["status_distribution"]
932	        terminated = status["terminated"]
933	        # Samples order by their label values: status first (completed, running,
934	        # then the terminated samples by ascending reason), which is the
935	        # ascending tuple-of-label-values order.
936	        lines: list[str] = [
937	            'chronicleflow_status_distribution{status="completed"} ' + str(status["completed"]),
938	            'chronicleflow_status_distribution{status="running"} ' + str(status["running"]),
939	        ]
940	        for reason in TERMINATION_REASONS:
941	            lines.append(
942	                f'chronicleflow_status_distribution{{status="terminated",reason="{reason}"}} '
943	                + str(terminated[reason])
944	            )
945	        for key in ("node_completions", "node_failures", "retry_consumption"):
946	            groups = counts[key]
947	            if groups:
948	                for label_value, value in groups.items():
949	                    lines.append(
950	                        f'chronicleflow_{key}{{node="{_prometheus_label(label_value)}"}} {value}'
951	                    )
952	            else:
953	                # A family with no facts still exposes one zero-valued sample.
954	                lines.append(f"chronicleflow_{key} 0")
955	        lines.append("chronicleflow_delivery_succeeded " + str(counts["delivery_succeeded"]))
956	        lines.append("chronicleflow_delivery_failed " + str(counts["delivery_failed"]))
957	        triggers = counts["schedule_triggers"]
958	        if triggers:
959	            for label_value, value in triggers.items():
960	                lines.append(
961	                    f'chronicleflow_schedule_triggers{{workflow="{_prometheus_label(label_value)}"}} {value}'
962	                )
963	        else:
964	            lines.append("chronicleflow_schedule_triggers 0")
965	        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
